name: Reality.eth
summary: Reality.eth, the crowd-sourced oracle's app, open source (GPL-3.0). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it reads the question list from an indexer, indexer.reality.gwei.name, without proof.
